memories.content: Ines is the curator at Marlin Bay gallery. She receives many unsolicited portfolios and typically only replies personally to those that strongly interest her. She has no prior knowledge of Yusuf.

Yusuf has a portfolio ready to send to Ines at Marlin Bay gallery via email. The gallery has an automated acknowledgment system that replies to incoming emails. Ines can choose to reply personally if she wishes.
